title_en: Apartment for sale at Casa Italia
description_en: Apartment for sale 1+1, located in Casa Italia, Tirana. The apartment has an area of ​​150 m2, 90 m2 apartment, 60 m2 veranda. It is organized in a living room and a separate kitchen area, a bedroom with access to the balcony, a toilet and a veranda. It is located on the 7th, last floor of a new and well-managed building. It has very high-quality works and is furnished with all the best brands. For sale fully furnished. Has Ownership Certificates.
